rows.concrete_observation: Complete866-line EliteKingBamBamBamEntity read, including all five anonymous summon bodies and magnetised-item body; minion admission copies are not proposed. Actual ELITE_KING_BAMBAMBAM factory field binds constructor. hurt snapshots health fraction, invokes super, then non-technical source crossing >25percent to<=25percent invokes collapse regardless returned success. No lethal-health clamp/revival guard in this override. collapse sets native invulnerable=true through AoAMonster setter (which also writes synced INVULNERABLE), drains energy to0, attempts five special hoglin summons and emits15 magnetised golden-apple item objects; does not set EXHAUSTED directly. Rest brain activity comes first, starts only energy==0, sets shared EXHAUSTED true, stops motion/navigation/path, plays same exhausted sound used for ordinary depleted-energy rest. Rest constructor supplies480 if invulnerable else160 runFor; shouldKeepRunning returns true while invulnerable, otherwise until energy150. stop clears EXHAUSTED and writes invulnerable false twice, then refills150. Native customServerAiStep after brain adds1 energy every5ticks; actual onDamageTaken drains floor(newDamage) only while notEXHAUSTED. registerControllers uses EXHAUSTED alone for held-down pose, so the same pose/sound can describe vulnerable normal rest or protected low-health collapse; it is not a per-hit rejection reason. Native super AoABoss has its separately credited void-return gate; AoAMonster.hurt calls multipart parent then vanilla parent. Magnetised items after delay approach exact boss: nearby players can intercept by proximity discard (not inventory reward), otherwise at distanceSq<3.1 heal50/addEnergy30/consume animation+sound+hearts and discard; hasPickUpDelay always true and empties item after5ticks. No spawn return checks for these ItemEntities. readAdditionalSaveData after super if native invulnerable sets HP to max/2 and keeps invulnerable true; own ENERGY defaults150 and EXHAUSTED defaultsfalse are not serialized here. No claim reloaded Rest continuation, world existence of each item/minion or guaranteed unmodified480tick duration.
